pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Classical, 9.f4
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8 and ...Rxc3. Reworded plan 2; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Classical, 9.f4
pages.notes: Plan 1 proposed a3 and Qd2 and a g4-g5 storm without meeting the pressure on d4 and b2; plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8 and ...Rxc3. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Classical, 9.Kh1
pages.notes: The overview said Kh1 sidesteps the long diagonal (it leaves the g1-a7 diagonal); plan 2 had Bh6 without Qd2; plan 3 aimed Black's play at a king that is on h1; plan 4 had ...Rxc3. Rewrote the overview and plans 2-4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Classical Variation, Alekhine Line
pages.notes: Plan 3 had a rook lift Re1-h1; plan 1 had an h4-h5 storm in front of White's own king. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Classical Variation, Bernard Defense
pages.notes: Plan 3 targeted a d6-pawn that has advanced to d5; plan 1 talked of an h4-h5 storm. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Classical Variation, Maróczy Line
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...a6 and ...b5 with ...Rxc3 and missed the ...Nc4 or ...Bc4 point of 10...Na5; plan 1 had a g4-g5 and h4-h5 storm instead of the main 11.f5. Rewrote plans 1 and 2; British spelling in the overview (fuelled, caught by the reviewer) and plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Classical Variation, Normal Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an f4-g4-h4 storm and Bh6 without Qd2; plan 2 had ...b5-b4 and ...Rxc3. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Classical Variation, Spielmann Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a rook lift h1-h3-g3 with no rook on h1. Rewrote plan 1 around the f5-pawn, the f-file and Qe1-h4; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Classical Variation, Tartakower Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an h4-h5 storm in front of White's king; plan 4 had ...Rxc3. Rewrote plan 1 around Kh1 and f5 or e5, reworded plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Classical, 9.Nb3 a6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Bc4 with the bishop on e2 aimed at d6; plan 4 had ...Rxc3. Rewrote plan 1, reworded plan 4; British spelling in plan 3.
